description:
Easy to learn, funny to play! With PokerTH you can play the popular texas holdem poker game. Try your skills against the computer opponents, and find many friends to play with in the online games.

Easy to learn, funny to play! With PokerTH you can play the popular texas holdem poker game. Try your skills against the computer opponents, and find many friends to play with in the online games.
- new: private messages to a player at a running table or offline are held back by the server and delivered later, and you can write to offline partners from existing conversations (QML; client & server)
- new: on Android tablets in landscape, chat and log/odds are docked next to the action bar and can be resized (QML)
- new: connection watchdog - a notice appears when the connection stalls, and dead connections are dropped faster (QML)
- new: Ukrainian translation (QML, by viteck1048)
- bugfix: the private message inbox was empty and not saved after a reconnect with the same nick (QML)
- bugfix: the guide counted players who left after being knocked out as still in the game (finishing place) (QML)
- bugfix: the start game button was shown to server admins who are not the table admin (QML)
- bugfix: the Android chat dropped the last word when sending with the button (QML)
- bugfix: the first tap on the Android chat input opened the edit menu instead of the keyboard (QML)
- bugfix: invitations were always rejected as busy after logging out and in again (QML)
- bugfix: a second rejoin login left a duplicate session (ghost player in the lobby) - the server now closes it, and the clients drop stale lobby entries with the same name (QML & widget & server)
- server: lobby chat log for moderation in <CacheDir>/chatlog (json lines, rotated every 72h, ServerChatLogRotateHours)
- server: log players leaving a running game (reason, cash), the cause of kicks, failed TLS handshakes, slow game start acks and rejoin decisions
- server: server passwords are no longer logged on an invalid password attempt
- server: script for a game-server restart when idle (tools/restart_when_idle.sh)
- android: Play Store release notes (de/en) via the workflow
- widget: bugfix build 2.1.9.3; QML clients from 2.1.10 on are accepted by the server
